review:
Haunted Reels is a neon-lit Halloween Megaways slot hosted by a skeleton. Wilds carry multipliers, and pumpkin scatters trigger one of three bonus versions.

The bonus uses coffins as symbols, which can reveal a chosen character, extra spins or a multiplier. Finding five multipliers releases them onto the reels for the biggest wins. The bonus buy lets you choose your volatility: Green is low volatility, Red is medium and Purple is very high, with the special symbol in Red and Purple chosen from the high-paying ones and Purple releasing its five multipliers twice. BGaming rates the base game medium-high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive often, roughly once every 123 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 123 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
